content:
maria: Quick sync on error taxonomy + rate-limit granularity for API launch. Need decisions today on per-route vs per-model limits and a consistent error shape for clients.
ajay: +1. My take: per-route for user-facing predictability, per-model as a soft internal throttle. We should expose `x-retry-after` / `Retry-After` header on 429s.
sam: For model-unavailable cases (OOM, node OOM, model not loaded) prefer 503 with a specific code `model_unavailable` and an optional `retry_after` in seconds. 429 -> client backoff; 503 -> short-term server issue or autoscale in progress.
lina: Also consider 409 for unsupported structured output request (e.g., user requested `response_format:json_schema` but model doesn't support structured output). 400 for schema/validation errors.
maria: Agree. Let's standardize codes across endpoints: chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, functions. Keep developer ergonomics first.
ajay: Proposal sketch for status mapping: 
- 400: validation (bad prompt, invalid params)
- 401/403: auth/permission
- 404: route/model not found (e.g., model id removed)
- 409: unsupported capability (structured-output unsupported, function-calling disabled)
- 429: rate limit (client) -> include `Retry-After` and `x-rate-limit-*` headers
- 503: transient model/unavailable or capacity constraints -> body code `model_unavailable` or `capacity_exhausted`
- 500: internal error (rare), include `request_id` for support
sam: For embeddings, add `rate_limit_scope: "embedding_units"` in issue docs. Embedding batch oversize -> 413 Payload Too Large with `max_batch_tokens`.
lina: Tool/function calling failures: distinguish between `tool_not_found` (404-ish) and `tool_error` (500-ish) returned by tool runtime. For tool errors surface `tool_name` in debug only (strip in prod logs unless support request).
ajay: Agree. Also: decide on rate-limit granularity. Option A: per-route, per-user, per-account. Option B: per-model, per-account. My recommendation: combine: primary limiter = per-account global token budget, secondary = per-route QPS. That helps prevent a single route spamming tokens.
maria: Customers asked for per-model limits (enterprise) — add as reserved feature for Dedicated. Public hosted defaults to per-account + per-route. Document in launch notes.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: infra/autoscaler will enable soft-eviction window 30s for scaling events.
ajay: Retry guidance for SDKs: 429 -> exponential backoff starting 500ms with max 10s and honor `Retry-After`. 503/capacity_exhausted -> linear backoff up to 60s and fall back to cheaper model if configured. 500 -> immediate report to support, no automatic retry by default.
sam: We should publish canonical error JSON shape. Draft: 
```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit",          // machine-readable: rate_limit, validation, model_unavailable, internal, capability"
    "message": "You exceeded your request quota", // human
    "code": "rate_limit",         // short code string
    "request_id": "req_01F...",
    "retry_after": 12,             // seconds, optional
    "details": { "scope": "per-route", "limit": "100rpm" } // optional
  }
}
```
maria: That looks good. Keep `error.code` concise. Add `hint` field for guidance? e.g., `hint: "reduce batch size or use embeddings:fast"`.
lina: SDKs can surface hint as structured suggestion. Good for PLG.
ajay: Launch gating checklist (quick):
- Spec doc merged + examples (docs) -> PR by EOD
- SDK changes: expose `retry_after`, `error.code`, and `error.hint` -> linn/ajay
- Console: show per-route throttles and historical 429 rates -> product/observability
- Dedicated: enable per-model limit config -> infra/enterprise
- E2E tests: simulate scaling + model unload -> eng-sre
maria: I'll own the spec doc. Lina take SDK, Ajay take API surface changes, Sam write model-side error tags. Can we commit to the 503 vs 429 messaging by EOD?
sam: Yes, I'll add model-side tags: `capacity_exhausted`, `model_unavailable`, and ensure runtime sets `retry_after` when we expect autoscale to help.
ops-bot: incident note: last week autoscaler scaled from 2->8 in 45s; recommend 30s `retry_after` for certain capacity errors.
ajay: One more: make `Retry-After` granular: if per-account token limit exceeded, include `x-account-retry-after`, else route-specific `Retry-After`. SDKs should honor the most specific header.
maria: Action items: create GH issue `api-error-taxonomy` with decisions, update swagger + examples, add a short guidance page in /docs/errors. I'll file and ping owners.
lina: I'll prototype SDK behavior and a small sample app demonstrating graceful fallback to cheaper model.
maria: Good. If no objections, I'll finalize spec with these decision points and add launch criteria: docs + SDK + console + 3 E2E tests.
ajay: No objections from me. :thumbsup:
sam: Sounds good.
ops-bot: OK: issue created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1428
maria: Thanks team — I'll post the spec link here when it's ready and assign follow-ups.
